mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee_rule (parking_lot_id, rule_name, free_minutes, billing_unit_minutes, unit_price, max_fee_per_24h, is_active, effective_from, effective_to, created_by) VALUES (#{parkingLotId}, #{ruleName}, #{freeMinutes}, #{billingUnitMinutes}, #{unitPrice}, #{maxFeePer24h}, #{isActive}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, parking_lot_id, rule_name, free_minutes, billing_unit_minutes, unit_price, max_fee_per_24h, is_active, effective_from, effective_to, created_by, created_at FROM fee_rule WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, parking_lot_id, rule_name, free_minutes, billing_unit_minutes, unit_price, max_fee_per_24h, is_active, effective_from, effective_to, created_by, created_at FROM fee_rule WHERE parking_lot_id = #{lotId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, parking_lot_id, rule_name, free_minutes, billing_unit_minutes, unit_price, max_fee_per_24h, is_active, effective_from, effective_to, created_by, created_at FROM fee_rule WHERE parking_lot_id = #{lotId} AND is_active = true
